description: Returns the Diversity Visa (DV lottery) rank cutoff for one region in a month's Visa Bulletin, or a country exception the bulletin lists within that region. Use it when a DV selectee asks whether their case number is current. For family and employment chart dates, use get_visa_bulletin. For the bulletin's advisory notes, use get_visa_bulletin_notes. A month or region not on file returns not_found. Free, no sign-in required. Limit: 20 calls per minute per IP, then rate_limited. Not legal advice. Source: the Department of State Visa Bulletin (travel.state.gov).

country.description: Chargeability country within the region; falls back to the region's "All" rate when the country has no listed exception, or when omitted

month.description: Bulletin month as YYYY-MM, e.g. "2026-10". A month not yet published or loaded returns not_found

region.description: DV region, exact: "Africa", "Asia", "Europe", "North America", "Oceania", or "South America and the Caribbean"

name: get_visa_bulletin_dv

cutoff_or_status.description: Rank cutoff: a case number such as "35000", or "C" (current: every case number qualifies)

title: Get Diversity Visa lottery cutoff
